post.description: Starts the business operation the entry belongs to (a sync run, the payment's own retry or status check, or a health check). The stored request is never replayed. 422 if the entry succeeded or is not retryable.
post.summary: Run again the operation behind a retryable failed log entry

post.description: Returns 202 with the run; poll GET /api/integrations/odoo/sync-runs/{id} until its status is no longer RUNNING. 409 if a run is already in progress.

get.summary: Stored status of each integration; makes no outbound call

post.description: Returns 202 with the run; poll GET /api/integrations/odoo/sync-runs/{id} until its status is no longer RUNNING. 409 if a run is already in progress.

Needs an Idempotency-Key header (generate one UUID per payment intention). 201 with the transaction in whatever state the payment service left it, including FAILED and TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN. Sending the same key and body again returns the same transaction (header Idempotent-Replay: true) and sends nothing. 409 if the invoice already has a successful or in-progress payment, or the key was used for another invoice.

get.summary: The transaction with every call made to the payment service for it

post.description: FAILED: a new attempt, up to the attempt limit. TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN: a status inquiry first; the request is sent again only if the payment service never received it.
post.summary: Send a FAILED payment again, or resolve a TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN one by inquiry

get.summary: The stored status only; makes no outbound call

post.description: A POST because it can change the transaction. 422 in any other status; 502 or 504 if the inquiry itself fails, in which case nothing changes.
post.summary: Ask the payment service what happened (PENDING and TIMEOUT_UNKNOWN only)

get.summary: Records of a run (the latest run when runId is left out)

post.description: Returns 202 with the run; poll GET /api/reconciliation/runs/{id} until its status is COMPLETED or FAILED.
post.summary: Reconcile a period (dates are UTC, both inclusive)
